recommendation_en: Multicomponent fortification of human milk is not routinely recommended for all preterm or low-birth-weight (LBW) infants but may be considered for very preterm (< 32 weeks’ gestation) or very LBW (< 1.5 kg) infants who are fed mother’s own milk or donor human milk. (Conditional recommendation, low-to-moderate-certainty evidence)
recommendation_zh: 不常规推荐对所有早产或低出生体重（LBW）婴儿进行多成分母乳强化，但对于喂养母亲自己的母乳或捐赠人乳的极早产（< 32周妊娠）或极低体重（< 1.5 kg）婴儿，可以考虑进行多成分母乳强化。（条件推荐，低至中等确定性证据）
